Author: Limber contributors
Name: Limber
Punchline: IK posing with on-body handles, plus a live link that mirrors Koikatsu poses, faces and animation.
Description:
Limber adds inverse kinematics posing on top of whatever pose a character already has.
- Drag on-body handles: hands and feet bend the arm or leg, elbows and knees swing the limb, head and chest bend the spine, hips move the body
- Pin hands and feet in place while the rest of the body moves
- Rotation gizmo on the selected handle
- Attach a bone to a bone on another character
- Works in GPose and, optionally, outside it
Koikatsu link (formerly KoiPoseLink): live-mirror up to 8 Koikatsu characters' pose, face and animation onto characters of any race, with optional private two-player sync. Needs the Limber Koikatsu sender plugin in Koikatsu.
Video tab: track a person's movement in a video file (body, optionally fingers) and play it on any character, with an accurate whole-body 3D model that runs on your graphics card.
VLC Live tab: the character follows whatever VLC is playing, live.
Everything happens on your PC and your screen only.
